# QCT Commerce

> QCT Commerce builds websites, e-commerce systems, search visibility and AI-supported digital sales infrastructure for businesses in Türkiye and Azerbaijan.

Verified contact: info@qctcommerce.com · WhatsApp: +90 545 678 26 55.

## Canonical language structure
- [Turkish](https://qctcommerce.com/)
- [English](https://qctcommerce.com/en/)
- [Azerbaijani](https://qctcommerce.com/az/)

TR, EN and AZ core commercial pages are reciprocal hreflang clusters. Azerbaijani is a full local-language site.

## Six core services
TR: /e-ticaret/ · /web-tasarim/ · /whatsapp-satis/ · /seo-geo/ · /meta-reklamlari/ · /yapay-zeka-otomasyonlari/
EN: /en/ecommerce/ · /en/web-design/ · /en/whatsapp-sales/ · /en/search-visibility/ · /en/meta-ads/ · /en/ai-automation/
AZ: /az/e-ticaret/ · /az/veb-dizayn/ · /az/whatsapp-satis/ · /az/seo-geo/ · /az/meta-reklamlari/ · /az/ai-avtomatlasdirma/

## Audiences
All three locales cover manufacturers, exporters, distributors/B2B and e-commerce brands.

## Knowledge base
The blog covers platform conditions, setup, search visibility and operational migration in TR, EN and AZ. The Turkish decision guides below have separate purposes; translations are linked only when real equivalents exist.
[Turkish blog](https://qctcommerce.com/blog/)
[English blog](https://qctcommerce.com/en/blog/)
[Azerbaijani blog](https://qctcommerce.com/az/bloq/)

## Turkish guides and free tools
- [Decision guide hub](https://qctcommerce.com/rehberler/): offer scope, channel economics, technical ownership and AI search checks.
- [Free calculator hub](https://qctcommerce.com/tr/araclar/): marketplace commission, website project range and e-commerce cost scenarios. Results depend on user inputs and stated assumptions.
- [Sector solutions hub](https://qctcommerce.com/sektorler/): eight industry-specific user journeys and website requirements.

## Selected topic clusters
- [Total marketplace sales cost](https://qctcommerce.com/rehberler/pazaryeri-komisyonlari-gercekten-ne-kadara-mal-oluyor/): SKU costs; complements the blog's platform-rate sources.
- [SEO, GEO, AEO and AIO definitions](https://qctcommerce.com/rehberler/ai-seo-geo-aeo-aio-nedir/): terms and practical responsibilities; no visibility guarantee.
- [Website offer comparison](https://qctcommerce.com/rehberler/2026-web-sitesi-fiyatlari/): scope checklist; current QCT service prices remain on /fiyatlar/.
- [Multilingual URL checks](https://qctcommerce.com/rehberler/cok-dilli-web-sitesi-seo/): real equivalents, canonical and hreflang; connects B2C e-export preparation with B2B export catalog needs.

## Programmatic SEO
Turkish market/location hubs: [Location hub](https://qctcommerce.com/lokasyon/)
English market/location hubs: [Location hub](https://qctcommerce.com/en/location/)
Both generate 19 parent market/location pages. Selected international markets generate 3 service-intent children (web design, e-commerce, SEO/GEO), producing 12 service pages per TR/EN locale.

The Azerbaijani locale intentionally does not duplicate the same Azerbaijan intent under /az/azerbaycan/. https://qctcommerce.com/az/ and its local service pages are the canonical Azerbaijan-market targets, preventing keyword cannibalization.

## Search and AI discovery
Pages use self-canonical URLs, reciprocal hreflang where translations exist, XML sitemap discovery, structured data and internal links. Core service pages use Service schema, blog articles use Article schema, and work examples use CreativeWork schema.

[Sitemap](https://qctcommerce.com/sitemap-index.xml)
[Robots](https://qctcommerce.com/robots.txt)

## Legal
Privacy, KVKK information, terms and cookie information are available in TR, EN and AZ. The AZ KVKK page is an informational translation/summary of the applicable Turkish notice; Turkish law and the Turkish notice govern formal interpretation.

QCT Commerce is part of the wider QCT ecosystem. QCT Studio is a separate sister brand.
